SELECT * FROM ( SELECT inner_q.*, ROWNUM rnum FROM ( SELECT g.game_code AS "game_code", g.game_title AS "game_title", g.game_desc AS "game_desc", g.game_contents AS "game_contents", g.game_developer AS "game_developer", g.game_publisher AS "game_publisher", g.publishing_date AS "publishing_date", NVL(g.game_price,0) AS "game_price", g.game_sale_price AS "game_salePrice", g.discount_per AS "discount_per", g.language_sup AS "language_sup", g.required_age AS "required_age", g.legal_notice AS "legal_notice", g.free_game AS "free_game", g.website AS "website", g.game_genre AS "game_genre", g.game_category AS "game_category", g.game_tag AS "game_tag", g.game_main_image AS "game_main_image", g.desc_images AS "desc_images", g.game_sys_req AS "game_sys_req", g.game_sys_req_r AS "game_sys_req_r", g.dlc_game AS "dlc_game", g.parent_game AS "parent_game", ( SELECT NVL(AVG(r.rating), 0) FROM gemdori_review_tbl r WHERE r.game_code = g.game_code ) AS gameRating FROM gemdori_game_tbl g WHERE 1=1
AND LOWER(game_title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{dto.keyword}) || '%'
AND LOWER(game_genre) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{dto.genres}) || '%'
AND game_price = 0
AND game_price < 20000
AND game_price < 40000
AND game_price < 60000
AND game_price >= 60000
AND game_rating < 1
AND game_rating >= #{dto.rating}
AND parent_game IS NULL
AND parent_game IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY publishing_date DESC, game_code
ORDER BY publishing_date, game_code
ORDER BY game_rating DESC, game_code
ORDER BY game_price, game_code
ORDER BY game_price DESC, game_code
ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(substr(game_code, 2))
) inner_q
WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE rnum > #{startRow}
